in_sanskrit.name: Sharvuksha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Sharvu + Ishwara (God) + Ksha (Energy)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvuksha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name for a girl derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharvu' meaning Goddess Sharvani, 'Ishwara' meaning God, and 'Ksha' meaning energy. This name signifies the power and strength of the goddess, as well as her role in the creation and sustenance of the universe.
